headline: US Military Repels Drones at UK RAF Lakenheath Base
summary: The US military used counter-drone technology to repel half a dozen drones swarming the RAF Lakenheath base in Britain, with suspected Iranian links.
why: Security incidents at strategic military installations highlight heightened defense readiness and geopolitical tensions involving allied defense assets.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: A military base located in the UK experienced a drone security incident.
